meta.title: STG/EML Paediatric Hospital 2023 — Materia seed gap triage
meta.note: Coverage triage only. Do NOT copy numeric doses from the PDF into Materia. Publish clinical values only after founder review with source + review gate. Paediatric dosing is especially high-risk — draft gate mandatory.
limitations: Paediatric Hospital 2023 PDF used as coverage pointer — PHC and Adult Hospital are separate gap sources
Name extraction can include class headings and blood products; priority list is curated
Neonatal and weight-based regimens must never be invented from model knowledge
Some medicines already scaffolded via Hospital Adults / PHC batches (e.g. artesunate, mebendazole)

outOfMoleculeScope: Blood products (packed red cells, FFP, albumin, factor concentrates)
Surfactant as a class without a single INN page decision
Oral rehydration solution / homemade SSS as a product page
Therapeutic class headings without a single INN
